description: Position of the main detector along the beam. With wavelength and chopper frequency this defines the configuration a run belongs to.
Mean neutron wavelength for the run. Part of the configuration identity; a mismatch against the run title is a known mislabelling case (protocol CAT-06).
Disc chopper rotation speed. Rounds to the standard 30 Hz or 60 Hz when forming the configuration id.
Total proton charge accumulated over the run. Divided by duration it gives the average beam current actually delivered.

Sample environment temperature reading for the run. The unit depends on the sample environment in use and is not recorded in the log, so the raw value is shown without one — check it against the environment before relying on it.
Aperture at the sample position. Feeds the Q resolution calculation; the reduction default is 10 mm unless the experiment specifies otherwise.
Aperture on the source side of the flight path, with the sample aperture setting the beam collimation.
Beamstop blocking the direct beam at the detector. Too small for the configuration and the direct beam reaches the detector.
Total detector counts recorded over the run.
Acquisition time for the run. A flood of a few seconds or a transmission of hours is usually an aborted or mislabelled measurement (protocol CAT-07).
